en.headline: US loses measles elimination status
en.body: The Pan American Health Organization has determined the United States no longer meets the criteria for measles elimination due to sustained domestic spread. The country had maintained this status since 2000, according to reports from The Jerusalem Post and Live Science.

fr.headline: Les États-Unis perdent leur statut d'élimination de la rougeole
fr.body: L'Organisation panaméricaine de la santé a déterminé que les États-Unis ne remplissent plus les critères d'élimination de la rougeole en raison d'une propagation locale persistante. Le pays conservait ce statut depuis 2000, selon des rapports du Jerusalem Post et de Live Science.

de.headline: USA verlieren Masern-Eliminierungsstatus
de.body: Die Panamerikanische Gesundheitsorganisation hat festgestellt, dass die Vereinigten Staaten die Kriterien für die Masern-Eliminierung aufgrund anhaltender inländischer Ausbreitung nicht mehr erfüllen. Laut Berichten des The Jerusalem Post und Live Science hatte das Land diesen Status seit 2000 beibehalten.

es.headline: EE. UU. pierde el estatus de eliminación del sarampión
es.body: La Organización Panamericana de la Salud ha determinado que Estados Unidos ya no cumple los criterios para la eliminación del sarampión debido a la propagación doméstica sostenida. El país había mantenido este estatus desde 2000, según informes de The Jerusalem Post y Live Science.

it.headline: Gli Stati Uniti perdono lo status di eliminazione del morbillo
it.body: L'Organizzazione Panamericana della Sanità ha stabilito che gli Stati Uniti non soddisfano più i criteri per l'eliminazione del morbillo a causa della diffusione interna sostenuta. Il Paese manteneva questo status dal 2000, secondo rapporti del The Jerusalem Post e di Live Science.

pt.headline: EUA perdem o estatuto de eliminação do sarampo
pt.body: A Organização Pan-Americana da Saúde determinou que os Estados Unidos não cumprem mais os critérios para a eliminação do sarampo devido à propagação doméstica sustentada. O país mantinha este estatuto desde 2000, segundo relatórios do The Jerusalem Post e Live Science.

zh.headline: 美国失去麻疹消除状态
zh.body: 根据《耶路撒冷邮报》和Live Science的报道，由于国内持续传播，泛美卫生组织已判定美国不再符合麻疹消除标准。该国自2000年以来一直保持此状态。

ja.headline: 米国、麻疹排除ステータスを喪失
ja.body: 汎米保健機関は、国内での持続的な感染拡大により、米国が麻疹排除の基準を満たさなくなったと判断した。この国は2000年以来このステータスを維持していたと、The Jerusalem PostおよびLive Scienceの報道による。

ko.headline: 미국, 홍역 박멸 지위 상실
ko.body: 범미보건기구는 지속적인 국내 확산으로 인해 미국이 홍역 박멸 기준을 더 이상 충족하지 못한다고 결정했다. 저널리즘 포스트와 라이브 사이언스 보도에 따르면 미국은 2000년부터 이 지위를 유지해 왔다.

en.headline: Measles cases exceed 5,400 in 2026
en.body: Health authorities have confirmed 5,412 measles cases in the United States so far this year. This figure represents more than double the total number of cases recorded in 2025, according to The Straits Times and Al Jazeera.

fr.headline: Plus de 5 400 cas de rougeole en 2026
fr.body: Les autorités sanitaires ont confirmé 5 412 cas de rougeole aux États-Unis depuis le début de l'année. Ce chiffre représente plus du double du nombre total de cas enregistrés en 2025, selon le Straits Times et Al Jazeera.

de.headline: Masernfälle übersteigen 5.400 im Jahr 2026
de.body: Gesundheitsbehörden haben in diesem Jahr bisher 5.412 Masernfälle in den Vereinigten Staaten bestätigt. Diese Zahl ist laut The Straits Times und Al Jazeera mehr als doppelt so hoch wie die Gesamtzahl der Fälle, die 2025 verzeichnet wurden.

es.headline: Casos de sarampión superan los 5.400 en 2026
es.body: Las autoridades sanitarias han confirmado 5.412 casos de sarampión en Estados Unidos hasta la fecha de este año. Esta cifra representa más del doble del total de casos registrados en 2025, según The Straits Times y Al Jazeera.

it.headline: I casi di morbillo superano i 5.400 nel 2026
it.body: Le autorità sanitarie hanno confermato 5.412 casi di morbillo negli Stati Uniti finora quest'anno. Questa cifra rappresenta più del doppio del numero totale di casi registrati nel 2025, secondo The Straits Times e Al Jazeera.

pt.headline: Casos de sarampo ultrapassam 5.400 em 2026
pt.body: As autoridades de saúde confirmaram 5.412 casos de sarampo nos Estados Unidos até ao momento deste ano. Este número representa mais do dobro do total de casos registados em 2025, de acordo com The Straits Times e Al Jazeera.

zh.headline: 2026年麻疹病例超5400例
zh.body: 据《海峡时报》和半岛电视台报道，美国今年迄今已确认有5412例麻疹病例。这一数字是2025年记录的总病例数的两倍多。

ja.headline: 2026年における麻疹症例が5,400件超
ja.body: 保健当局は、今年に入ってからの米国における麻疹症例を5,412件と確認した。これは、The Straits TimesおよびAl Jazeeraによると、2025年の全症例数の2倍以上にあたる。

ko.headline: 2026년 홍역 사례 5,400건 초과
ko.body: 보건 당국은 올해 미국에서 현재까지 5,412건의 홍역 사례가 발생했음을 확인했다. 스트레이츠 타임스와 알자지라에 따르면 이 수치는 2025년 기록된 총 사례 수의 두 배 이상이다.

en.title: US loses measles elimination status as cases exceed 5,400 in 2026
en.dek: Health authorities confirm 5,412 measles cases this year after Pan American Health Organization revokes elimination status
facts: Pan American Health Organization determined United States no longer meets criteria for measles elimination due to sustained domestic spread
United States had maintained measles elimination status since 2000
Health authorities confirmed 5,412 measles cases in United States so far in 2026
More than double the total number of cases recorded in 2025
Measles-associated deaths in United States reach 10 after two more deaths reported
Outbreaks of measles have spread across dozens of states
body: The Pan American Health Organization has determined the United States no longer meets the criteria for measles elimination due to sustained domestic spread, revoking a status the country had maintained since 2000 according to The Jerusalem Post and Live Science.

Health authorities have confirmed 5,412 measles cases in the United States so far this year, a figure that represents more than double the total number of cases recorded in 2025 according to The Straits Times and Al Jazeera.
Measles-associated deaths in the United States have reached 10 after two more deaths were reported according to Al Jazeera.
Outbreaks of measles have spread across dozens of states following the revocation of elimination status as reported by multiple outlets.
The United States had maintained measles elimination status since 2000 before the Pan American Health Organization's determination based on sustained domestic spread.
Health officials continue to monitor the situation as cases exceed 5,400 in 2026 according to confirmed reports from multiple sources.
en.context: The United States had maintained measles elimination status since 2000 before the Pan American Health Organization determined the country no longer meets the criteria due to sustained domestic spread, with cases exceeding 5,400 in 2026 and associated deaths reaching 10.
